description: This file defines the AccessFlowStateMachineService class, which manages workflow state transitions and permissions in the Human Resource Management System. It interacts with DAO classes to retrieve and modify workflow states, actions, and role-based permissions.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing workflow state transitions, permissions, and related operations within the HRM system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the DAO object to interact with workflow state data.

methods.name: setAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO object for dependency injection or testing purposes.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Fetches allowed actions for a specific workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Retrieves allowed workflow items with caching based on workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is permitted in the current workflow state with the given role.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Determines the subsequent state resulting from a given action in the workflow.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Obtains all states related to recruitment applications accessible by the role.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Provides a list of states where specific actions can be performed for a role.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Fetches workflow state machine records, optionally filtered by role.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Persists a single workflow state machine record.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecordAsArray
methods.description: Bulk saves an array of workflow state machine records.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific workflow state transition record.

methods.name: getAllowedCandidateList
methods.description: Retrieves candidates permitted for the role (stub implementation).

methods.name: getAllowedProjectList
methods.description: Retrieves projects permitted for the role (stub implementation).

methods.name: getAllowedVacancyList
methods.description: Retrieves vacancies permitted for the role (stub implementation).

methods.name: getAllowedCandidateHistoryList
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history entries permitted for the role (stub implementation).

methods.name: getWorkflowItem
methods.description: Fetches a workflow item by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Retrieves a workflow item filtered by workflow, state, action, and role.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Deletes all workflow records associated with a specific user role.

methods.name: handleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Updates workflow records when a user role is renamed.

methods.name: resetWorkflowCache
methods.description: Clears the cached allowed workflow items.
